ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Visible distribution of approximately 30% high-intensity (white) to 70% low-intensity (dark/grey) pixels across the exposed fluke area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep trajectory on distal edges ending in sharp, tapered, slightly upturned lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single light-colored linear disruption visible on the dark surface of the left lobe mid-section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring/lesions localized on the lateral tips and along sections of the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced pigmentation asymmetry between the left and right lobes.
